# NGLView

| Tool | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| [add_arrows](add_arrows.ipynb) | Adding 3D graphical vector arrows to NGLView interactive visualization widgets |
| [add_contacts](add_contacts.ipynb) | Adding contact distance cylinders and representations to NGLView widgets |
| [add_cylinders](add_cylinders.ipynb) | Adding custom 3D geometric cylinders between spatial points to NGLView widgets |
| [add_hbonds](add_hbonds.ipynb) | Adding hydrogen bond representations to NGLView interactive visualization widgets |
| [clear](clear.ipynb) | Clearing all graphical representations and components from an NGLView widget |
| [load_html_in_jupyter_notebook](load_html_in_jupyter_notebook.ipynb) | Displaying a standalone exported HTML NGLView visualization inside a Jupyter Notebook |
| [set_color](set_color.ipynb) | Applying uniform or selection-specific color schemes to NGLView components |
| [set_color_by_value](set_color_by_value.ipynb) | Mapping numerical per-atom or per-residue values to continuous colormaps on NGLView widgets |
| [show_as_balls_and_sticks](show_as_balls_and_sticks.ipynb) | Rendering molecular selections as ball-and-stick representations in NGLView |
| [show_as_cartoon](show_as_cartoon.ipynb) | Rendering macromolecular secondary structure as ribbon/cartoon representation in NGLView |
| [show_as_licorice](show_as_licorice.ipynb) | Rendering molecular selections as licorice bonds in NGLView |
| [show_as_surface](show_as_surface.ipynb) | Rendering molecular surface representations in NGLView |
| [show_gui](show_gui.ipynb) | Enabling the interactive graphical user interface controls on NGLView widgets |
| [standardize_view](standardize_view.ipynb) | Applying MolSysMT standardized camera orientations, lighting, and viewport defaults to NGLView |
| [write_html](write_html.ipynb) | Exporting an interactive NGLView 3D visualization as a standalone HTML file |
